# TalkOps

> Open-source multi-agent AI platform for DevOps, SRE, Cloud, and Platform Engineering—operating across an interactive Terminal UI, headless CI/CD pipelines, two-way ChatOps, and 24/7 autonomous incident webhooks while keeping cloud credentials local.

This repository (`talkops-ai/talkops`, PyPI package `talkops-ai` providing `talkops` and `ops` CLIs, Apache-2.0) is built on Python 3.12+, LangGraph, DeepAgents, and the TypeSafe AI Jev System-1 classification engine. TalkOps executes directly against your native local credential chains (`aws`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, `tofu`, `helm`, `az`, `gcloud`)—or inside isolated cloud sandboxes—across 26+ LLM providers (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, Codex, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, and custom `--base-url` endpoints) with zero cloud secret exfiltration. Agents and RAG pipelines needing the complete, single-file technical manual can fetch [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) directly.

TalkOps operates across four unified execution modes:

- **Interactive Terminal UI (`talkops` / `ops`)**: Textual TUI with live multi-cloud and Kubernetes context switching (`/cloud`, `/aws`, `/azure`, `/gcp`, `/k8s`), 3-tier Jev Smart Mode routing (`--smart`, `/pool`), Goal & Rubric verification (`/goal`), Stagehand Chrome Browser Automation (`/browser`), durable OpenWiki codebase indexing (`/openwiki`), and Specialist Subagent delegation or 1-on-1 Persona Mode (`/agent`).
- **Headless CLI & CI/CD Rubric Gate (`talkops -p`)**: Non-interactive execution supporting piped `stdin`, `--json`, `--max-turns`, `--timeout`, `--read-only`, and self-verified `--rubric` checklists (plus the composite GitHub Action `talkops-ai/talkops@main`).
- **Central Server & Addon Microkernel (`talkops serve`)**: Shared SQLite or PostgreSQL team runtime across 5 server profiles (`default`, `api-only`, `webhook-worker`, `sre`, `enterprise-full`) with OIDC/JWT auth (`core-auth`), multi-user thread sharing and `/fork` branching (`client-gateway`), two-way **Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Discord** ChatOps (`channels`), context-graph correlation (`context-graph`), and Stratified AutoQA (`intelligence`).
- **Autonomous Webhook Incident Triage (`POST /webhooks/{provider}`)**: 9 built-in webhook adapters (PagerDuty, Prometheus Alertmanager/Grafana, AWS SNS/CloudWatch/EventBridge, Datadog, ServiceNow, GitHub, Jenkins, CNCF CloudEvents, and Generic/Azure Monitor/Opsgenie/Jira/Argo CD/GitLab) with HMAC verification, alert-storm deduplication, QuickJS `js_eval` isolated plugin-subagent dispatch, and automated ticket and chat RCA write-backs.

Install on macOS/Linux/WSL2 with `curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talkops-ai/talkops/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`, on Windows PowerShell with `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talkops-ai/talkops/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex`, or via `uv tool install --python 3.12 talkops-ai`. Production safety is enforced through `--read-only` boundaries, `<100ms` zero-token Jev System-1 blast-radius gating, deterministic `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse` hooks with secret-env sanitization, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approvals across terminal and chat channels.

## Core Documentation

- [Project Overview & Quickstart (README)](README.md): High-level feature summary, installation commands, local/BYOK model setup, first interactive/headless/server workflows, and GitHub Action PR rubric example.
- [Complete Single-File LLM Reference](llms-full.txt): Consolidated, token-efficient Markdown reference covering all TalkOps execution modes, CLI flags, `/slash` commands, server addons, webhooks, subagents, `config.toml`, and `addons.json` schemas in a single fetch.
- [Architecture & Operational Modes Overview](docs/talkops-docs/overview.md): Deep dive into TalkOps's four execution modes (TUI, Headless CLI, Central Server, Webhooks), multi-agent orchestration, Jev Smart Mode, and DevOps/SRE use cases.
- [Step-by-Step Quickstart Guide](docs/talkops-docs/quickstart.md): End-to-end onboarding for installing `talkops` (`ops`), signing in via `talkops auth login --sso`, configuring local Ollama or cloud LLM keys, verifying tools with `talkops doctor`, and running your first cloud audit.
- [CLI & Slash Command Reference](docs/talkops-docs/cli-reference.md): Complete lookup reference for all `talkops` flags, CLI subcommands (`serve`, `auth`, `threads`, `openwiki`, `plugin`, `addon`, `skills`, `agents`, `mcp`, `doctor`, `benchmark`), keyboard shortcuts, and interactive `/slash` commands.

## Execution Modes, Safety & Browser / Sandbox Runtimes

- [Approval Modes & Jev Smart Mode](docs/talkops-docs/approval-mode.md): How `smart`, `manual`, `auto`, and headless `yolo` modes govern command execution, sub-70ms 3-tier model pool routing (`Fast`, `Standard`, `Powerful`), `<100ms` System-1 blast-radius evaluation, and `/permissions` rules.
- [Goal Mode & Acceptance Rubrics](docs/talkops-docs/goal-and-rubrics.md): Autonomous multi-step objective planning (`/goal`, `--goal`), live task tracking, and deterministic pass/fail verification checklists (`--rubric`, `/rubric`) for CI/CD pull request gates.
- [Browser Automation Agent (`/browser`)](docs/talkops-docs/browser-automation.md): Stagehand-powered Chrome automation subagent (`snapshot`, `run`, `screenshot`, `browser_handoff`) with 3-tier live Chrome `DevToolsActivePort` SSO reuse, 8 KB head+tail snapshot truncation, DevOps/SRE dashboard playbooks (Grafana, Datadog, Argo CD, AWS/GCP/Azure consoles), SSRF protection, and destructive-action HITL gates.
- [Remote Cloud Sandboxes (`--sandbox`)](docs/talkops-docs/remote-sandboxes.md): Running shell commands and file edits inside isolated, disposable containers across Modal, Daytona, Runloop, LangSmith, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, and Vercel Sandbox with workspace synchronization.

## Central Server, Incident Webhooks & Two-Way ChatOps

- [Central Server & Multi-User Collaboration](docs/talkops-docs/central-server.md): Deploying `talkops serve` with SQLite or PostgreSQL (`--postgres-uri`), API-key/JWT/OIDC authentication, shared team threads (`--server-url`, `-r`), and non-destructive `/fork` thread branching.
- [Webhooks & Automated Incident Response](docs/talkops-docs/webhooks.md): Configuring all 9 built-in webhook receivers and 22 shorthand URL aliases (`/webhooks/{pagerduty,alertmanager,sns,datadog,servicenow,github,jenkins,cloudevents,generic}`), alert-storm deduplication, two-stage incident cards, and ticket/PR RCA write-backs.
- [Server Addons & `addons.json` Reference](docs/talkops-docs/server-addons.md): Addon Microkernel architecture, built-in addons (`core-auth`, `client-gateway`, `webhooks`, `channels`, `context-graph`, `intelligence`), server profiles (`default`, `api-only`, `webhook-worker`, `sre`, `enterprise-full`), marketplace CLI (`talkops addon`), and 4-tier `addons.json` configuration.
- [Slack App Portal & ChatOps Setup](docs/talkops-docs/slack-portal-setup.md): Configuring Slack Events API, Block Kit Interactivity, `/talkops` slash commands, two-stage threaded incident war-rooms, HITL approval buttons/reactions, and `Confirm RCA` / `Dispute Hypothesis` card locking.
- [Discord Developer Portal & ChatOps Setup](docs/talkops-docs/discord-portal-setup.md): Setting up Discord Gateway v10 WebSocket + Ed25519 HTTP Interactions, forum/text incident threads, ActionRow button approvals, 👍/👎 reactions, and DM sender pairing.
- [Microsoft Teams & Azure Bot Setup](docs/talkops-docs/teams-portal-setup.md): Wiring a Single-Tenant Azure Bot Messaging Endpoint (`POST /channels/teams/events`), Teams `manifest.json`, 1:1 DMs and channel threads, and Adaptive Card v1.5 `Action.Execute` HITL and RCA feedback workflows.
- [Server Addon Developer Guide](docs/talkops-docs/developer-guide/server_addon_developer_guide.md): Authoring custom Python server addons (`TalkOpsServerAddon`), mounting Starlette/FastAPI routes, subscribing to `HookEventBus` events, triggering `AgentRunGateway` runs, and packaging `.talkops/addon.json` manifests.

## Configuration, Credentials & Model Providers

- [Configuration Overview & Precedence](docs/talkops-docs/Configuration.md): End-to-end precedence hierarchy across CLI flags, environment variables, project `.talkops/` files, `~/.talkops/.env`, and `~/.talkops/config.toml`, plus live `/config` and `/reload` management.
- [`config.toml` Schema Reference](docs/talkops-docs/config.toml.md): Complete key-by-key reference and starter template for `[cloud]`, `[aws]`, `[azure]`, `[gcp]`, `[k8s]`, `[devops]`, `[models]`, `[effort]`, `[agent_pool]`, `[security]`, `[sandboxes]`, `[interpreter]`, `[async_subagents]`, and `[ui]`.
- [Credentials, SSO & Cloud Contexts](docs/talkops-docs/credentials.md): Managing OS Keyring and `~/.talkops/.env` LLM credentials (`talkops auth`), Control Plane SSO, and instant switching across AWS profiles/roles, Azure subscriptions, GCP projects, Kubernetes contexts, and `@ambient` / `@in-cluster` identities (`/cloud`).
- [Model Providers & Custom Endpoints](docs/talkops-docs/model-providers.md): Configuring all 26+ built-in LLM providers, local Ollama models, enterprise cloud endpoints (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI), reasoning effort levels (`/effort`), and self-hosted `--base-url` gateways (vLLM, LiteLLM, LM Studio).

## Subagents, Plugins, Knowledge & Extensibility

- [Specialist Subagents (`/agent`)](docs/talkops-docs/subagents.md): Automatic parallel subagent delegation (`task` and isolated QuickJS `js_eval` dispatch for plugin subagents), interactive 1-on-1 Specialist Persona Mode (`/agent`, `detach`, `attach`, `clear` handoff summaries), custom `.talkops/agents/*.md` authoring, and remote `[async_subagents]`.
- [Plugins & Marketplaces (`/plugins`)](docs/talkops-docs/plugins.md): Installing, scoping (`user`, `project`, `local`), and authoring Agent Plugins, Vertical Skill Packs, and Partner Integrations from `talkops-ai/devops-plugins` or private Git marketplaces (`talkops plugin`).
- [Persistent Memory & `SKILL.md` Runbooks](docs/talkops-docs/memory-and-skills.md): Always-on `AGENTS.md` instructions, `.talkops/memory/` key-value notes, `/remember` knowledge distillation, and 3-stage progressive disclosure `SKILL.md` playbooks (`/skills`, `talkops skills`).
- [OpenWiki Codebase Knowledge Base (`/openwiki`)](docs/talkops-docs/openwiki.md): Compiling and querying a Git-versioned `openwiki/` architecture index (Open Knowledge Format v0.2) with SHA-256 Grounded Claims (`file_exists`, `file_lines`, `symbol`), drift detection, and model-free BM25 + graph retrieval (`talkops openwiki`).
- [Custom Slash Commands (`.talkops/commands/`)](docs/talkops-docs/custom-commands.md): Defining zero-code Markdown `/commands` with YAML frontmatter, `$ARGUMENTS` and named parameters, live inline `` !`shell` `` output injection, `allowed-tools` brace expansion, and `context: fork` subagent execution.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools](docs/talkops-docs/mcp-tools.md): Connecting local `stdio` and remote `http`/`sse` MCP servers via `.mcp.json`, workspace trust verification, lazy `call_mcp_tool` schema hydration, and subagent-isolated MCP server scoping (`talkops mcp`).
- [Event & Lifecycle Hooks (`hooks.json`)](docs/talkops-docs/hooks.md): Running audit scripts on operational events (`webhook.received`, `webhook.completed`, `tool.use`) and intercepting execution via `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, and `SubagentStart` matchers with automatic secret-env sanitization.

## Ecosystem Marketplaces & Companion Repositories

- [TalkOps DevOps Plugins Marketplace](https://github.com/talkops-ai/devops-plugins): Official Apache-2.0 marketplace (`talkops-devops-plugins`) providing 20 AWS & Kubernetes specialist subagents (`aws-sre-agent`, `aws-finops-engineer`, `aws-cloud-security-engineer`, `kubernetes-observability-engineer`, `kubernetes-delivery-engineer`, etc.), 21 AWS vertical skill packs, and 8 partner-built plugins (Terraform, Crossplane, Elastic, Honeycomb, Coralogix, LaunchDarkly, Neo4j, Bronto).
- [TalkOps DevOps Plugins `llms.txt`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talkops-ai/devops-plugins/main/llms.txt): Machine-readable `llmstxt.org` catalog of every specialist agent, vertical skill bundle, partner plugin, slash command, and scoped MCP binding in `talkops-ai/devops-plugins`.
- [TalkOps DevOps MCP Servers (`talkops-mcp`)](https://github.com/talkops-ai/talkops-mcp): Production DevOps and Cloud-Native MCP servers for Prometheus (`prom_*`), Alertmanager (`am_*`), Grafana Loki, Grafana Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, Helm, Kargo, and Traefik.
- [TalkOps Server Addons Marketplace (`talkops-addons`)](https://github.com/talkops-ai/talkops-addons): Official server addon catalog (`channels`, `webhooks`, and extensible organization integrations) consumed by `talkops addon` and `talkops serve`.

## Optional

- [Composite GitHub Action (`action.yml`)](action.yml): Reusable GitHub Action definition (`uses: talkops-ai/talkops@main`) for automated Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, and FinOps Pull Request rubric checks with PR comment write-back.
- [Example PR Rubric Workflow](examples/github-actions/talkops-rubric-pr-check.yml): Ready-to-copy `.github/workflows/` YAML pipeline running TalkOps read-only PR rubric verification in GitHub Actions.
- [Kubernetes Security Rubric Example](examples/rubrics/k8s-security-rubric.md): Sample acceptance rubric enforcing non-root pod security contexts, CPU/memory limits, probes, and least-privilege RBAC.
- [Terraform & FinOps Rubric Example](examples/rubrics/terraform-finops-rubric.md): Sample acceptance rubric enforcing IAM least privilege, encryption at rest, required cost-allocation tags, and cloud spend guardrails.
- [Python Package Metadata (`pyproject.toml`)](pyproject.toml): Python 3.12+ dependencies, optional extras, entry points (`talkops`, `ops`), and tool configuration.
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): Developer setup with `uv`, unit test and linter workflows (`pytest`, `ruff`), architecture conventions, and pull request guidelines.

- [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Contributor Covenant community standards.

- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io): Open protocol connecting AI agents to external infrastructure tools and telemetry sources.
